integrity: Nine-leaf all-tree upper bound is proved mathematically, including arbitrary subdivisions. Finite lower bounds are certified by complete explicit adaptive trees, independently replayed and checked by an exact version-space recurrence. No external independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Extremal Littlestone values established only for two through ten leaves; no classification of all extremizing trees or ranks above ten; source priority remains uncertain under phylogenetic/split-system aliases.
title: Nine leaves are the first entropy-deficient case for online shattering by tree geodesics
